_meta.note: Frozen. The phase categories follow the Localize/Reproduce/Fix/Verify/Other split used in arXiv 2609.20804, reworked for diagnosing a live system. Changing any wording invalidates comparison with earlier runs; make a new id instead.

phase.instructions: What is this step of the investigation doing? Judge the action that was taken and what it returned. Pick the single best description.

criteria.survey: Looking broadly at the whole system without a specific suspect yet.
criteria.localize: Narrowing from many components to a smaller set of suspects.
criteria.inspect: Reading the configuration or state of one specific suspect in detail.
criteria.probe: Actively exercising the system to see how it behaves, rather than reading state.
criteria.verify: Checking whether a change had the intended effect.
criteria.report: Writing up or submitting a conclusion rather than investigating.
